title: Unified intake-to-pinflow with micro-smoke and semantic-profile gating
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that takes community OSS weights from intake through deterministic conversion, multi-format artifacts (TorchScript/ONNX/Q4 quantized blobs), automated micro-smoke against runtime variants, and publishes a canonical performance profile and a recommended pin with rollback metadata. The goal is to make a single, auditable flow that reduces manual touchpoints, surfaces semantic regressions early, and outputs a pin suggestion with confidence scores and fallback options.
acceptance_criteria: Intake hook accepts weights bundles with manifest and provenance and stores immutable artifact
Conversion step produces deterministic TorchScript and ONNX artifacts with hashes reproducible across two independent runs
Micro-smoke suite runs against dedicated canary pool and validates functional parity (top-k token agreement >= 98%) and latency SLOs for 3 sequence shapes
Semantic-profile generator publishes dataset-level metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/Perplexity proxies, embedding drift) to profile catalog
Pin recommender suggests a canonical pin with confidence score, primary fallback, and automated rollback policy metadata
Pipeline emits telemetry events for each stage, and gating rules block publishing if any safety heuristic or semantic drift > threshold
End-to-end run time for average 7B model is <= 45 minutes on staging conversion workers
Docs and runbook updated with rollback and manual override steps
decisions: Use ONNX as the canonical intermediate format for cross-runtime validation plus a TorchScript artifact for runtime compatibility when available
Deterministic normalization: fix RNG seeds, standardize weight ordering and common metadata stripping during conversion
Micro-smoke targets three canonical sequence shapes: short (32), mid (128), and long (1024) to capture KV-cache behavior
Semantic profile uses a compact eval set (200 examples) with embedding-based drift + paired generation similarity rather than large-scale corpora to keep runtime low
Pin recommendation will be scored by weighted heuristics: functional parity (40%), perf/latency (30%), memory fit (15%), and safety checks (15%)
tasks: Write intake manifest schema and validate signer fields
Implement deterministic conversion pipeline (TorchScript + ONNX + quantizer) and publish artifact metadata
Build micro-smoke harness and integrate into canary pool execution
Implement semantic-profile generator and profile catalog publisher
Create pin-recommender service that outputs pin, confidence score, fallback pins, and rollback policy
Add telemetry events and gating rules in pipeline orchestration
Author runbook for failures and manual pin override flows
Create e2e integration test that simulates a community weight intake and goes through publish flow
progress_updates: 2025-11-21: Kickoff meeting — scoped expected artifacts and owners. Assigned conversion to Diego, semantic-profile to Maya.
2025-12-10: PoC deterministic conversion built; reproducible hashes across two runs for a small 1.3B model. Found non-determinism from layernorm eps differences — patched converter.
2026-01-05: Micro-smoke harness prototype completed. Short and mid sequences pass functional parity; long sequence exposes a KV-cache mishandling in runtime-1.18 — filed ENG-100122 for runtime fix.

2026-02-02: Semantic-profile generator finalized (200 example eval set) and first profiles published to staging catalog. Observed embedding drift metric works and correlates with manual eval on 3 models.

2026-02-20: Pin recommender initial algorithm implemented and validated against 12 historical model onboarding cases — recommended pins matched our canonical pins in 10/12 cases. Tuned weights to penalize safety heuristics more heavily.
2026-03-03: Telemetry gating integrated; one simulated bad intake was blocked due to safety tokenizer mismatch. Good end-to-end smoke completed for 2 community models on staging.
2026-03-10: Preparing docs and runbook for release. Need final SRE review and a small runtime patch before we can flip publish to production.
notes: Blocker: runtime-1.18 KV-cache issue (ENG-100122) must be resolved for stable long-sequence smoke; workaround exists by reducing long seq test to 512 for now
Follow-up: add a nightly job that replays accepted pins against the latest runtime to detect regressions
Security: ensure KMS-protected manifests for private community weights before publishing pins to production catalog
